title: Output-sensitive three-query adapter
statement: Let a Boolean circuit encoding and a semantic PCPP reduction be given, and suppose every circuit's PCPP description has a positive query count. An output-sensitive adapter consists of an output-sensitive PCPP reduction for that encoding whose semantic output, on every Boolean circuit of positive input length, is exactly the three-query PCPP description obtained by transforming the given reduction's output.
hypotheses_covered: Positive query count for every output description
